description: SMS Input - Crash is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This file contains the publicly available crash data used for the current month’s SMS calculations. Contains a record for each commercial motor vehicle involved in a crash including the U.S. DOT, Report Number, Crash Date, State, and Vehicle Information. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 22 columns, among them Seq_Num, Injuries, Vehicle_License_number, DOT_Number, Report_State, Fatalities. The portal shows 2026-09-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
